title: Forensic Photo - Deposit Worksheet/Cash Count Sheet Handwriting and Entries (EV004)
prompt:
1) Function: Capture a forensic-quality close-up photograph of a cash count/deposit worksheet emphasizing handwriting and filled entries for later examination.
2) Scene / Composition: A single paper deposit worksheet/cash count sheet lies flat on a neutral, unpatterned tabletop surface, filling ~85% of the frame. The sheet shows multiple handwritten entries in dark ink across several fields/lines, with no names or business identifiers visible. A small L-shaped forensic scale (black-and-white) is placed adjacent to the lower edge of the paper without covering any text. A small plain arrow evidence marker labeled “2” sits near one corner of the sheet, indicating the area of interest without obscuring writing.
3) Angle & Distance: 20° off perpendicular (slight oblique) from above, camera-to-subject distance 0.45 m.
4) Optics & Technique: 60 mm lens, aperture f/11, shutter 1/80 s, ISO 200, white balance 5000 K. Focus locked on the handwriting mid-page with deep DOF to keep the entire sheet legible; raking light from camera-left at a low angle to reveal pen pressure/indentations while maintaining even exposure.
5) Mandatory elements: Color image; close-up perspective; raking light; forensic scale present; annotation present via a single numbered evidence marker (“2”); no additional labels, timestamps, or case identifiers.
6) Negatives: No real names, no brand logos, no letterheads of real companies, no faces, no hands/fingers, no official seals/badges, no credit card numbers, no bank account numbers, no barcodes/QR codes, no addresses, no phone numbers, no added timestamps, no writing of evidenceId/title/caseId in the image, no cluttered background, no glare hotspots obscuring text.
7) Acceptance checklist: - Single color photo of one cash count/deposit worksheet with visible handwritten entries
- Sheet occupies ~85% of frame and is fully in focus and legible
- Raking light clearly reveals subtle texture/indentation without harsh glare
- L-shaped forensic scale included and not covering any text
- One numbered evidence marker “2” present as the only annotation
- No people, brands, real identifiers, or timestamps visible
- Neutral tabletop background with clean edges and forensic-quality sharpness
